seo_description: Explore MEVCO’s proposed services spanning market assessment, importation, distribution, retailer development and brand activation.
p_01: MEVCO is developing the commercial and operational capabilities to help international brands establish and grow their presence in Lebanon.
h2_01: From market evaluation to retailer activation.
p_02: Our operating model is designed to support manufacturers beyond the initial shipment.
p_03: Category research, competitor review, consumer positioning and initial product selection.
p_04: Product classification and coordination with qualified local specialists, where required.
p_05: Development of compliant logistics, inventory, warehousing and delivery arrangements.
p_06: Structured outreach to relevant pharmacies, baby retailers, specialty stores and e-commerce channels.
p_07: Retail materials, product education, promotional plans and coordinated product introductions.
p_08: Periodic reporting on sales activity, retail penetration and opportunities to improve performance.
p_09: Tell us about your product portfolio and objectives for Lebanon. We welcome conversations about potential distribution partnerships.
